d: Recently confirmed exoplanets and benchmark nearby discoveries.

lhs-1140-b.x: Temperate habitable-zone Super-Earth or potential water world 48 light-years away in Cetus, confirmed by JWST to possess a nitrogen-dominated atmosphere.

barnard-b.x: Sub-Earth mass exoplanet discovered in 2024 orbiting Barnard's Star with a 3.15-day period, detected using ESO ESPRESSO on the Very Large Telescope.

eps-ind-ab.x: Cold super-Jupiter directly imaged by JWST MIRI at 12 light-years, the coldest and oldest exoplanet ever imaged around a Sun-like star.

proxima-centauri-d.x: Sub-Earth candidate orbiting Proxima Centauri every 5.1 days at just 4.25 light-years, one of the lightest known extrasolar planets.

teegarden-s-star-d.x: Earth-mass exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of an ultra-cool red dwarf 12.5 light-years from Earth, confirmed in 2024.

b.s: Curated selection of breakthrough exoplanets discovered or characterized in recent observational campaigns.
